```text
# #4513: Patch: the AI's quality gates are held to win rates measured on today's AI, so the daily run notices when it gets weaker
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every day an automatic check plays the computer opponent against two simple opponents, and its Hard level against its Easy level, and fails if it wins too few games. How many wins count as too few is worked out from how often the AI was once measured to win. That measurement was taken in September, on an earlier version of the AI, and nobody has taken it again since. The spot checks that AI changes report suggest today's AI beats the simple 'greedy' opponent far more often than it did then, so the bar sits so low that the AI could lose a large part of its strength and the daily check would still pass. Once this is built there is a command that takes the measurement again on fresh deals, it is taken once, and the bar moves up to match. The maintainer finds out when an AI change makes the opponent weaker; players notice nothing directly.

## Why

- `AI_GATE.measured_rate` (`crates/ai/src/gate.rs:119-123`: 0.945, 0.68, 0.913) is the TypeScript AI's measurement (`docs/polish/3-ai.md:912`), unchanged since the Rust port landed it on 2026-10-07 (`bb77b7d2fc`). 237 commits have touched `crates/ai/src` since, among them the learned evaluation's retirement (R4159000) and R4132000's beam change.
- `gate_needed` (`gate.rs:175-182`) derives every floor from it: against greedy, 10 of the smoke run's 20 and 28 of the daily full run's 50.
- The smoke runs that AI patches report read far above that against greedy: 16, 16, 20, 20, 19, 18, 16 and 16 of 20 (R2564000, R2603000, R2687000, R2688000, R3064000, R3822000, R4171000, R4065000). An AI that wins 68% makes 19 or more of 20 with a 0.5% chance. Those 20 seeds are fixed, so the runs are not fresh samples. That is why the rate needs measuring again, not reading off them.
- What that costs: an AI fallen to 60% against greedy still passes the daily full run 77% of the time (28 of 50 needed). Measured at 80%, the floor would be 35 of 50, and the same AI would pass 10% of the time.
- Hard against Easy reads the other way. Its latest runs sit at 15 and 16 of 20, at its floor (R4132001), which a 91.3% AI falls to only about 9% of the time. There the brief's 75% caps the floor anyway.
- §9.9 and R4132001 hold `measured_rate` to 'a measurement of fresh deals and not a choice', and the constant's own comment says it is measured on tuning deals. No tool can measure it today:
  - `arena` refuses `greedy` (`crates/tools/src/arena.rs`, `parse_agent`) and deals no Hard handicap.
  - `run_games` (`crates/ai/src/gate.rs:302-310`) plays only `AI_GATE.seed_series`.
  - `trace` plays one game.

## Proposal

1. `cargo jackioh gate --measure [--games N]` plays each of the three matchups on the tuning series `AI_TUNING_SERIES` (`tune:<matchup>:<n>`), never the gate's `gate:v3`. It runs in parallel as the gate does, at `AI_GATE_BUDGET`, with each game folded back to its hash as now (B31).
   - For each matchup it prints the wins, the games, the rate with its 95% Wilson interval, and the turn-cap draws.
   - It also prints the counts `gate_needed` would ask at 20, 50 and 100 games with that rate.
   - It judges no floor, and exits 1 only on an unclean game.
   - In the AI crate, `run_games` takes the series instead of reading `AI_GATE.seed_series`.
2. The same pull request runs it once, at 300 games or more per matchup (the spec's own measurement was 1,000, 1,000 and 300), and records the tallies in a new ruling.
3. `measured_rate` takes each measured rate that is higher than today's. A rate measured lower keeps today's value and is named in the pull request and the ruling, since §9.9 wants the user's sign-off before a rate is lowered.
4. Update to match:
   - §9.9's 'On fresh deals…' sentence, and its 'short of the brief' sentence if greedy now clears 70%;
   - `docs/polish/3-ai.md:912`;
   - the tests in `crates/tools/src/gate.rs` that pin the counts (`check_gate_rule` and R4132001's).

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/gate.rs` (the series parameter)
- `crates/tools/src/gate.rs` (`--measure` and its tests) and `crates/tools/README.md` (the `gate` row)
- `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.9 (Quality gates)
- `spec/rulings/R<issue>000.md` and `spec/pending/<issue>.md`
- `docs/polish/3-ai.md`
- `crates/ai/README.md`, wherever it restates the rates

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate --measure --games 2` plays seeds named `tune:…` for every matchup and none named `gate:v3…`; a test reads the seeds.
- [ ] The printed rate is wins over games, and the interval is the Wilson interval; a unit test checks a known tally.
- [ ] Two runs of the same size print the same tallies, whatever the thread count.
- [ ] A ruling records the measurement: the commit, the games per matchup, the wins and the interval for each, the wall time and the machine.
- [ ] `measured_rate` holds the measured rates where they are higher; any lower one is unchanged and named in the pull request.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) passes on the pull request's head under the new floors, its tallies quoted in the pull request.
- [ ] §9.9's fresh-deal sentence states the new measurement.

## Size and risks

- **Size:** medium. The tool is about 150 lines plus tests.
- **CPU time:** about 900 games at 300 a matchup. By the training lanes' '400 games, 25 to 45 minutes' on a two-core box, that is roughly half an hour to an hour on four cores, inside one bot run.
- **Risk:** higher floors make the daily `ai gates` run red when an AI change costs strength, which is the point. Under the 5% false-alarm rule they also do so now and then by chance, as today.
- **Left alone:** the Duos gate's greedy floor, from its own '168 of 200 on fresh deals' (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:116-120`).
```

## Goal

Provide a measurement mode `cargo jackioh gate --measure [--games N]` that plays all three matchups on fresh tuning deals (`AI_TUNING_SERIES`, `tune:<matchup>:<n>`), printing wins, games, win rates with 95% Wilson intervals, turn-cap draws, and projected `gate_needed` floors across 20, 50, and 100 games without evaluating floors (exiting 1 only on unclean games). Run the measurement at 300+ games per matchup, document the findings in ruling `R4513000` and `spec/pending/4513.md`, raise `AI_GATE.measured_rate` for matchups where the rate measured higher than today's baseline while keeping any lower rate unchanged, and update §9.9 and related documentation and count-checking tests to match.

## Files to touch

| File | Status | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/gate.rs` | change | Parameterize `run_games` with `series: &str`; export `run_tuning_gate_games` and `gate_needed_with_rate`; update `AI_GATE.measured_rate` for higher measured rates |
| `crates/tools/src/gate.rs` | change | Add `--measure` flag and update `--games` in `Args`; add `DEFAULT_MEASURE_GAMES`; implement `measure_matchups` and summary output in `run()`; add tests for `tune:` seeds, known Wilson tally, and R4513000 |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | Update `gate` row to document `--measure [--games N]` |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | In §9.9 ("Quality gates"), update the fresh-deals measurement sentence and amend the "short of the brief" note if greedy clears 70% |
| `spec/rulings/R4513000.md` | new | Record measurement results (commit, games, wins, 95% Wilson interval, turn-cap draws, wall time, machine) and ruling rationale |
| `spec/pending/4513.md` | new | Pending §11 paragraph for R4513000 |
| `docs/polish/3-ai.md` | change | Update `measuredRate` line 912 to reflect higher measured rates |

Must not touch:
- Any file under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, or `bot/`.
- Engine rules (`crates/engine/src/rules/`, `crates/engine/src/loop_.rs`).
- Card scripts (`crates/cards/src/scripts/`).
- AI search and evaluation heuristics (`crates/ai/src/search/`, `crates/ai/src/eval/`).
- Database migrations and server code (`crates/server/`).
- Web client code (`apps/web/`, `apps/edge/`, `apps/admin/`, `e2e/`).

Spec sections and rulings governing the change:
- SPEC §9.9 (Quality gates)
- R4132001 (Hard against Easy's 75% floor and measured rate rules)
- R850000 / R1994000 / R3049001 (95% Wilson score interval)
- B28–B31 (Quality gate matchups, seeds, clean execution invariants)
- CLAUDE.md rules 3 (rulings), 4 (purity), 9 (named constants), 11 (difficulty rating)

## Steps

1. **Parameterize seed series in `crates/ai/src/gate.rs`:**
   - In `run_games` (`crates/ai/src/gate.rs`), add `series: &str`:
     ```rust
     fn run_games(
         matchup: Matchup,
         numbers: &[i32],
         budget: SearchBudget,
         series: &str,
         config_for: fn(Matchup, i32, SearchBudget, &str) -> MatchConfig,
     ) -> GateReport
     ```
   - Update `config_for` call inside `run_games` from `AI_GATE.seed_series` to `series`.
   - Update `run_gate_games` and `run_fixture_gate_games` to pass `AI_GATE.seed_series`.
   - Add public helper for tuning runs:
     ```rust
     /// Plays the listed matchup games on the tuning series (`AI_TUNING_SERIES`).
     pub fn run_tuning_gate_games(matchup: Matchup, numbers: &[i32], budget: SearchBudget) -> GateReport {
         run_games(matchup, numbers, budget, AI_TUNING_SERIES, game_config)
     }
     ```
   - Extract `gate_needed_with_rate`:
     ```rust
     /// Wins needed for `matchup` given an arbitrary win rate: max k where
     /// P(Binomial(games, rate) >= k) >= 1 - false_alarm, capped at ceil(brief_rate * games).
     pub fn gate_needed_with_rate(matchup: Matchup, games: i32, rate: f64) -> i32 {
         let mut k = 0;
         while k < games && binomial_tail(games, rate, k + 1) >= 1.0 - AI_GATE.false_alarm {
             k += 1;
         }
         k.min((AI_GATE.brief_rate[matchup] * f64::from(games)).ceil() as i32)
     }
     ```
   - Implement `pub fn gate_needed(matchup: Matchup, games: i32) -> i32` by delegating to `gate_needed_with_rate(matchup, games, AI_GATE.measured_rate[matchup])`.

2. **Add CLI flags and constants in `crates/tools/src/gate.rs`:**
   - Define named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9):
     ```rust
     const DEFAULT_MEASURE_GAMES: usize = 300;
     ```
   - In `Args`:
     ```rust
     /// Measure the AI's win rates across all three matchups on tuning deals (AI_TUNING_SERIES).
     #[arg(long, conflicts_with_all = ["full", "shard", "out", "duos"])]
     pub measure: bool,
     /// With `--duos` or `--measure`: the games to play per matchup (defaults: DUOS_GATE_GAMES_SMOKE for duos, 300 for measure).
     #[arg(long, value_name = "N")]
     pub games: Option<usize>,
     ```
   - In `pub fn run(args: Args) -> Result<()>`:
     - Check: if `args.games.is_some() && !args.duos && !args.measure`, return `Err(anyhow!("--games requires either --duos or --measure"))`.
     - Check: if `args.measure`:
       ```rust
       jackioh_cards::register_all();
       let games = args.games.unwrap_or(DEFAULT_MEASURE_GAMES);
       return measure_matchups(games);
       ```

3. **Implement measurement execution and reporting in `crates/tools/src/gate.rs`:**
   - Implement `fn play_measure_matchup(matchup: Matchup, played: &[i32]) -> GateReport`:
     ```rust
     fn play_measure_matchup(matchup: Matchup, played: &[i32]) -> GateReport {
         play_gate_with(matchup, played, run_tuning_gate_games)
     }
     ```
   - Implement `fn measure_matchups(games: usize) -> Result<()>`:
     - Track `problems: Vec<String> = Vec::new()`.
     - For each `matchup` in `matchups()`:
       - Generate `played = (1..=games as i32).collect::<Vec<_>>()`.
       - Run `let started = Instant::now();` and `let run = play_measure_matchup(matchup, &played);`.
       - Let `seconds = started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();`.
       - Validate clean execution:
         ```rust
         if let Err(error) = check_report(&run, &played) {
             problems.push(format!("{}: {error:#}", matchup_name(matchup)));
         }
         if let Err(error) = check_clean(&run) {
             problems.push(format!("{}: {error:#}", matchup_name(matchup)));
         }
         ```
       - Calculate interval and projections:
         ```rust
         let (low, high) = jackioh_engine::wire::stats::wilson_interval(run.wins as i64, games as i64);
         let n20 = gate_needed_with_rate(matchup, 20, run.rate);
         let n50 = gate_needed_with_rate(matchup, 50, run.rate);
         let n100 = gate_needed_with_rate(matchup, 100, run.rate);
         let name = matchup_name(matchup);
         println!(
             "[gate measure {name}] {} wins and {} turn-cap draws of {games}; rate: {:.3} (95% Wilson: [{:.3}, {:.3}]); needed: 20 -> {n20}, 50 -> {n50}, 100 -> {n100} ({seconds:.1}s)",
             run.wins, run.turn_cap_draws, run.rate, low, high
         );
         ```
     - If `problems.is_empty()`, return `Ok(())`. Otherwise return `Err(anyhow!("unclean games:\n{}", problems.join("\n")))`. Notice: do not judge floors or fail on win count.

4. **Add tests in `crates/tools/src/gate.rs`:**
   - Seed verification test:
     ```rust
     #[test]
     fn measure_plays_tuning_series_and_no_gate_seeds() {
         jackioh_cards::register_all();
         let played = [1, 2];
         for matchup in matchups() {
             let run = play_measure_matchup(matchup, &played);
             assert_eq!(run.games.len(), 2);
             for game in &run.games {
                 assert!(game.seed.starts_with("tune:"), "seed {} does not start with tune:", game.seed);
                 assert!(!game.seed.contains("gate:v3"), "seed {} contains gate:v3", game.seed);
             }
         }
     }
     ```
   - Known Wilson interval tally test:
     ```rust
     #[test]
     fn measure_tally_and_wilson_interval_known_counts() {
         let wins = 65;
         let games = 100;
         let rate = wins as f64 / games as f64;
         assert_eq!(rate, 0.65);
         let (low, high) = jackioh_engine::wire::stats::wilson_interval(wins, games);
         assert_eq!(
             (jackioh_engine::wire::stats::round_share(low), jackioh_engine::wire::stats::round_share(high)),
             (0.553, 0.736)
         );
     }
     ```
   - Proving test for R4513000:
     ```rust
     #[test]
     fn r4513000_measure_gate_tuning_series_is_clean() {
         jackioh_cards::register_all();
         let played = [1, 2];
         for matchup in matchups() {
             let run = play_measure_matchup(matchup, &played);
             check_clean(&run).expect("tuning series games must be clean");
         }
     }
     ```

5. **Run the measurement and capture figures:**
   - Execute:
     ```bash
     cargo run --release -p jackioh-tools -- gate --measure --games 300
     ```
   - Record the wins, turn-cap draws, win rates, Wilson interval bounds, wall-clock time, commit hash, and CPU/machine architecture.

6. **Update measured rates and documentation:**
   - In `crates/ai/src/gate.rs`:
     - Compare each measured rate against `AI_GATE.measured_rate`:
       - `ai_vs_random`: if > 0.945, update to measured rate; else keep 0.945.
       - `ai_vs_greedy`: if > 0.680, update to measured rate; else keep 0.680.
       - `hard_vs_easy`: if > 0.913, update to measured rate; else keep 0.913.
   - In `docs/polish/3-ai.md:912`, update `measuredRate` to match `AI_GATE.measured_rate`.
   - In `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.9:
     - Update the sentence: "On fresh deals the AI wins 94.5% ± 0.7 of 1,000 against random and 68.0% ± 1.5 of 1,000 against greedy, and as Hard 91.3% ± 1.6 of 300 against Easy." to reflect the new 300-game measurements and their Wilson intervals.
     - If greedy measured rate clears 70%, amend the "Against greedy that is short of the brief..." sentence.
   - In `crates/tools/src/gate.rs`:
     - Run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools gate` to check if `r4132001_...` or `check_gate_rule` need updated assertions if floors shift.
   - In `crates/tools/README.md`:
     - Update line 33 to include `gate --measure [--games N]`.

7. **Create Ruling and Pending entries:**
   - Create `spec/rulings/R4513000.md`:
     - Frontmatter: `id: R4513000`, `title: "Fresh-deal measurement of the AI's win rates and gate floors (issue #4513)"`, `cards: "§9.9, R4132001, issue #4513"`, `proven_in: [crates/tools/src/gate.rs]`.
     - Body: record commit hash, 300 games per matchup, wins, 95% Wilson interval, turn-cap draws, wall-clock runtime, machine specs, which rates were updated vs kept, and rejected alternatives (e.g. lowering any rate without explicit user approval, skipping clean execution check).
   - Create `spec/pending/4513.md`:
     - Format: `**[[R4513000]] Fresh-deal measurement of the AI's win rates and gate floors (issue #4513, 2026-11-22)**: ...`

8. **Run verification commands:**
   - `cargo jackioh spec check`
   - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`
   - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools gate`
   - `cargo run --release -p jackioh-tools -- gate` (smoke run passes under new floors)
   - `cargo fmt --check`
   - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`

## Tests

- `crates/tools/src/gate.rs`:
  - `measure_plays_tuning_series_and_no_gate_seeds`: asserts `cargo jackioh gate --measure --games 2` plays seeds prefixed with `tune:` and no seeds containing `gate:v3`.
  - `measure_tally_and_wilson_interval_known_counts`: asserts rate is wins / games and Wilson interval matches known reference points (`wilson_interval(65, 100)` -> `[0.553, 0.736]`).
  - `r4513000_measure_gate_tuning_series_is_clean`: proves ruling R4513000 by verifying tuning series games run cleanly under B31 invariants.
- Verification commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools gate`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`
  - `cargo run --release -p jackioh-tools -- gate`

## Done when

- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate --measure --games 2` plays seeds named `tune:…` for every matchup and none named `gate:v3…`; proven by test.
- [ ] Printed rate is wins over games and interval is the 95% Wilson interval; proven by unit test on known tally.
- [ ] Parallel execution via Rayon preserves deterministic ordering and identical output regardless of thread count.
- [ ] Measurement run executed at 300 games per matchup and recorded in `spec/rulings/R4513000.md` with commit, wall time, machine, wins, and intervals.
- [ ] `AI_GATE.measured_rate` in `crates/ai/src/gate.rs` and `measuredRate` in `docs/polish/3-ai.md` updated for any rate measured higher (lower rates kept unchanged).
- [ ] §9.9 updated with new fresh-deal measurements.
- [ ] `spec/pending/4513.md` added and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes cleanly.
- [ ] `crates/tools/README.md` documents `gate --measure [--games N]`.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` smoke run passes on the new floors.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass cleanly.

## Risks

- **Flaky or red gate after raising floors:** Higher `measured_rate` raises `gate_needed` floors for daily runs and smoke checks. Avoided by: only raising rates that are statistically demonstrated on 300+ fresh deals, capping at brief rates, and verifying `cargo jackioh gate` smoke passes with head commit.
- **Lower measured rate without sign-off:** §9.9 explicitly prohibits lowering `measured_rate` without user sign-off. Avoided by: retaining current `measured_rate` for any matchup where the new measurement is lower, and explicitly documenting this in the ruling and PR notes.
- **Seed contamination:** Tuning measurements must never reuse gate seeds, which would invalidate future test independence. Avoided by: strictly using `AI_TUNING_SERIES` (`"tune"`) and asserting `!seed.contains("gate:v3")`.
- **Determinism under multithreading:** Parallel game execution across Rayon threads could theoretically sort games non-deterministically if not indexed. Avoided by: mapping indexed game numbers with `par_iter()` and flattening back into original order, identical to `play_gate_with`.

## Open questions

None. The issue specification, §9.9 rules, and acceptance criteria completely settle the requirements.

````markdown
     ```rust
     /// Wins needed for `matchup` given an arbitrary win rate: max k where
     /// P(Binomial(games, rate) >= k) >= 1 - false_alarm, capped at ceil(brief_rate * games).
     pub fn gate_needed_with_rate(matchup: Matchup, games: i32, rate: f64) -> i32 {
         let mut k = 0;
         while k < games && binomial_tail(games, rate, k + 1) >= 1.0 - AI_GATE.false_alarm {
             k += 1;
         }
         k.min((AI_GATE.brief_rate[matchup] * f64::from(games)).ceil() as i32)
     }
     ```

## Risks

- **Flaky or red gate after raising floors:** Higher `measured_rate` raises `gate_needed` floors for daily runs and smoke checks. Avoided by: only raising rates that are statistically demonstrated on 300+ fresh deals, capping at brief rates, and verifying `cargo jackioh gate` smoke passes with head commit.
- **Lower measured rate without sign-off:** §9.9 explicitly prohibits lowering `measured_rate` without user sign-off. Avoided by: retaining current `measured_rate` for any matchup where the new measurement is lower, and explicitly documenting this in the ruling and PR notes.
- **Seed contamination:** Tuning measurements must never reuse gate seeds, which would invalidate future test independence. Avoided by: strictly using `AI_TUNING_SERIES` (`"tune"`) and asserting `!seed.contains("gate:v3")`.
- **Determinism under multithreading:** Parallel game execution across Rayon threads could theoretically sort games non-deterministically if not indexed. Avoided by: mapping indexed game numbers with `par_iter()` and flattening back into original order, identical to `play_gate_with`.
````
